'''Delona''' was an individual who served as [[Giradda]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] translator, though Giradda often grew irritable at [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] matches and threatened to kill Delona in various ways, such as offering to let the winning team eat Delona.
